prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE full-frame 16:9 landscape watercolor-pencil narrative still for a video, no collage.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image 1 is the authoritative character identity/model sheet: copy its childlike 2.6-head-tall silhouette, round simple face, short round chin, pale grey-white short hair in a few broad clumps with green tips, thick grey-black headphones with green rings, plain forest-green pullover hoodie with kangaroo pocket, grey shorts, barefoot. Copy Image 1's gentle pencil-watercolor handling, not its blank eye interiors. Image 2 is used ONLY to complete the eyes: large ROUND eyes with olive-green irises, dark centered pupils, one small highlight and visible whites; do not copy its pose or interior setting. Image 3 is the approved round-faced, eye-completed style reference and the SAME cream folded paper map prop, NOT a scene reference; do not copy its town environment or walking pose. The face must remain the simple ROUND face of Image 1, never long-eyed or sharp-chinned. Short simple hair, not many spiky fine strands. Clothing plain with a few soft folds, no dense pattern or high-detail etching.
Art direction: gentle natural pencil outline, softly layered watercolor, delicate light paper grain, soft sunlight, blue sky, fresh green and blue-green mountains, warm natural stone with lavender-grey shadows. Natural varied colors, not a yellow-grey monochrome wash. All surroundings organically fill all four edges.
Mountain setting shared across the three shots: a safe broad gradually ascending natural stone path on a green hillside, with low shallow stone steps and roomy flat landings. The path continues toward screen right and curves back into higher hills. Healthy low grass and small natural stones beside the path, open sky and distant blue-green ridges. No dangerous cliff, no narrow bridge, no summit, no urban town.
Composition safety: whole character visible. Place the whole head, both arms/hands, both legs and both bare feet within vertical 20% to 77% of the canvas. The lowest 22% remains naturally painted broad foreground ground/path and a little grass, NOT a blank strip, NOT a graphic reserved panel. Show clear anatomical continuity: exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, two separate bare feet connected naturally to body.
No text, letters, digits, labels, captions, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, floating diagrams, icons, panels, borders or artificial empty footer. The map only has delicate pictorial hills, a soft blue stream and an ochre route, no words or symbols. The image is a loose personal-growth hiking metaphor, never a factual HUMAN3.0 workflow or score.
SHOT 1 — TAKING THE NEXT STEP, THE PATH HAS LEVELS.
Medium-wide environmental shot, camera at a comfortable front three-quarter angle so the simple round face and both olive eyes are visible, character looking toward the next shallow stone step to the right. Character left of center, smaller within the landscape, approximately from 24% to 73% image height. Depict a readable weight-bearing action: one bare foot is firmly planted on the lower broad tread, while the other bare foot is being set onto the next shallow broad step, that knee naturally bent; torso shifts forward slightly, clear stable balance, no jumping. The left hand holds the SAME cream paper map from Image 3 folded loosely into a small rectangle by the side, the other arm extends gently for natural balance, both hands visible. Both feet are separate, the lifted foot actually reaches the raised stone.
Ahead at screen right there is a clearly visible spacious intermediate landing, then another short series of low steps continuing into the hills. These spatial layers express growth through stages, without triumph or guarantee. Keep the gentle hopeful everyday effort in the round face. Do not copy the frontal strolling pose of Image 3. The stepping pose, stone levels and weight shift must be unambiguous.

targeted_revision.prompt: Edit Image 4 only, a single targeted composition correction. Images 1,2,3 remain mandatory identity references: Image 1 is highest-priority simple rounded character silhouette and pencil watercolor, Image 2 only gives round olive irises/pupils, Image 3 is approved round face style and cream map. Do not copy their scenes. Keep the mountain path, natural blue sky, green hills, warm stone, colors, camera direction, map, and stepping action of Image 4. Keep two hands and two bare feet physically connected. The ONLY requested change is make the whole character smaller within this scene, repositioning naturally on the same broad stair. Current character spans y=13% to 83%; corrected character must span y=23% to 74%, leaving naturally painted sky/mountains above and at least 25% of uninterrupted natural foreground stone path below. Keep head round, cheeks wide, chin short and rounded as Image 1, short broad green hair tips, same headphones and plain hoodie and shorts. The lower planted foot and upper stepping foot must BOTH be above 75% image height. Do not crop or scale the entire image; repaint the character at a smaller scene-relative size and integrate its feet into appropriate step treads. Keep stable forward weight shift, one hand holding folded cream map and other hand balancing. 16:9 full frame. No border, text, symbols, watermark, blank footer, or scene discontinuity.

inspection.identity: round face, olive irises and pupils, green-tipped white hair, headphones, plain hoodie and shorts visible
inspection.action: two hands and two bare feet connected; map held; upper/lower step weight shift clear
inspection.composition: full-frame mountain scene; lowest bare foot approx y=79.6%, slightly below requested 78% boundary; foreground remains natural
